method: Join all 244 editable-project source dimensions to indexed full virtual texture package candidates and actual PC Texture2D records. Dimensions use mips[highest_available_mip_index]; available exported PNG IHDR dimensions are crosschecked.
proposal_policy: A sole full virtual package may be proposed when it is an exact leaf match, or (direct textures only) an explicit _HD match. Multiple full paths remain ambiguous; _Desktop and collision-suffix-only candidates are not automatically proposed.
comparison_policy: actualhigher/lower require both dimensions to be respectively no smaller/no larger with at least one strict change; same requires both equal; mixed dimensions are ambiguous. Missing source/measurement is missing.

metadata_scope.priority_scope: Sources are selected by this provider for the stated input tree. Provider order is recorded, not independently verified against a live game.

limitations: Dimension increases establish available resolution only; they do not verify texture semantics, visual quality, material compatibility, UV layout, or successful project replacement.
Provider metadata covers the stated base Content/Paks input tree. Saved update archives remain indexed candidates but are not proven live mount priority or replacement sources.
All proposed sources and replacements remain unverified. Ambiguous full paths are retained without selecting one.
Exact VMGen leaf matches do not establish atlas/crop or UV equivalence; generated texture substitutions require separate material/UV evidence.
Current dimensions describe imported source metadata; they are not current resident GPU mip dimensions.
